owning_layer: CurveRegion2 inherited topology policy validation, consumed by Hypercurve finite region projection and strict native SVG export; CSGRS delegates to these owners.
domain: Canonical empty regions and exact regularized empty results, alone or beside supported finite wires and paths. Existing symbolic qualified-empty constructions remain qualified.
missing_acceptance: A wholly empty exact SVG document must export, validate its zero-root native graph, replay deterministically, and remain a valid operand. An empty region whose topology consumed approximation must not disappear from strict export validation merely because a stroke supplies finite bounds.
expected_representation: Reuse the existing version5 compound native graph with zero definitions and path roots. A unit display viewport supplies an explicit finite rendering convention and is not a geometric bound or an authoritative region.
constraints: Validate all export options and inherited region topology before empty shortcuts; preserve unsupported, invalid, undecided and exhausted failures from nonempty operands. Do not weaken extension-byte minimums or manufacture geometry from the viewport. No wire-format change or second region kernel.
baseline: Reproduce against the byte-identical selected-circle-corners candidate while its qualification runs, using its source-attributed compiled library. No source edit in that worktree.
downstream: Native SVG region and legacy path replay, full Hypercurve owner tests, CSGRS SVG adapter and affected profile consumers, strict Clippy/docs/core build, capability guards and matrix, formatting/typos/repository budget. Complete repository workflow gate before a push.
resource_contract: Existing finite projection, decoded extension byte and definition-depth limits remain distinct. No total arithmetic, retained-memory or cancellation guarantee is added. External probe timeouts are containment only.
publication: A separate incremental commit after the selected-circle-corners candidate is qualified and committed. Original failing tests and source snapshots are retained.

findings: Canonical and self-difference empty regions fail export with Geometry(cannot serialize SVG without finite geometry).
A qualified empty region with a finite quadratic stroke exports successfully, bypassing inherited topology policy.
Public strict finite region projection returns Ok([]) for the qualified empty region.

reproduced_findings.finding: Strict normalization unexpectedly accepts the returned empty result before the approximate replay assertion. The loss begins at arrangement empty publication, not solely at later validation. No implementation edits yet.

projection_contract: Strict projection must reject an inherited approximate topology; approximate-requested projection may consume it and retain Approximate512Consumed. Reuse region-owned validation with typed CurveError before the empty return, and keep the existing exact wrapper mapping.

composition_findings.boolean: Strict union accepts and discards qualified empty input.
composition_findings.affine: Identity transform accepts inherited qualified topology without observing its receipt.
composition_findings.offset: Zero and both signed round offsets already preserve topology receipts.
composition_findings.fix: Validate both Boolean operand receipts before shortcuts, keep inherited requirements on returned carriers and validate affine replay before identities. An exact policy reuses the shared carrier; changing the dependency gets separate caches with identical retained boundary definitions.

qualification.parent_transition: The corner source is frozen separately; after its complete qualification and commit, update only parent metadata and three receipts, prove every nonreceipt byte unchanged, and rerun receipt checks. Any implementation change invalidates this child qualification.
